textField:
Giving a great presentation is fun if you remember a few simple rules! First, always try to look at your *audience* instead of staring at your screen. It is important to speak *clearly* so everyone in the room can hear your amazing ideas. Take a deep *breath* and speak a little more *slowly* and loudly. Avoid using *filler* words like "um" or "uh" and skip any long, awkward pauses.
If you want to keep your friends engaged, try to ask them a *question* during your talk. Make sure you *practice* your presentation. Finally, remember to *smile*. Everyone wants you to succeed!
